examples.arabic: بعدين خلص الست شنط التانية في ساعتين بس.
examples.english: Then he finished the other six bags in two hours only.
examples.transliteration: Baaden khallas el-set shonat el-tanya fi saateyn bas.

examples.arabic: لما اليوم خلص ودعت صاحبتي وروحت البيت اريح شوية قبل ما اشوف جدتي
examples.english: When the day finished, I said goodbye to my friend and went home to rest a bit before seeing my grandmother
examples.transliteration: Lamma el youm khilis wadda3t saHibtī we rowwaHt el beit areyyaH shwaya qabl ma ashoof gaddeti

examples.english: No, there's no milk, it finished yesterday.
